policy_summary: The official fair-data-usage page displays Updated: 04/11/26 and says requests for commercial, AI-usage, and model-training purposes should assume no data-use permission is granted. Free CSV/Excel data are described as intended for private individuals' personal betting and/or academic interest and research, with at most two light automated download sessions per week. The page does not grant this project AI-inference permission.
policy_interpretation: The original MARKET_ANCHOR_1X2_V2 uses the source as input to an AI model. The current provider policy explicitly addresses AI usage and says permission should be assumed absent. General personal/academic research language is not treated as an AI-inference licence. No source capture, feature construction, V2 inference, or evaluation using this provider is permitted until provider-issued written permission or an applicable open licence is recorded and SHA-verified. AI training, commercial use, and public product use remain forbidden.
